nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan steps 4 + 6, Unity write path (docs/IMMERSIVE_SCENE_PIPELINE.md sections 5-6): callable name compose_room(scene_id?, objects?, room_name, connection_insight?, images?, sounds?, environment?, particles?, player_eye_height?). With a scene_id (list_scenes) the uploaded photo becomes a metric Gaussian-splat scene placed by scene_layout.photo_room_layout so the player stands where the camera was, with the separately reconstructed objects as grabbable splats in their photo positions; without one, objects stand upright on an arc at label sizes. Defaults come from the scene's vision analysis: CC0 HDRI sky, key/fill/rim and practical lights (colour temperature, direction, brightness), fog, particles, floor texture, curated ambient sound; web images become a peripheral gallery facing the player, sounds ambience or object-attached; every web asset is credited. Emits a room spec (JSON) and a few lines of Unity_RunCommand C# that call SketchScape.RoomKit.Build(spec) by reflection, finalize code calling RoomKit.Finalize(slug, spawnX, spawnZ, yaw), which since RoomKit 1.0.16 also does the Meta XR setup itself (camera rig, interaction rig, grab on every object, teleport hotspots) plus SketchScapePickup on grabbables, QuestPerformance foveation on the rig and an MSAA-free Android quality level, and status code calling RoomKit.Status(slug) (one JSON line of what is done, so a build resumes instead of restarting). The spec's performance block makes RoomKit use the sync's Quest-sized splat copies (<file>_quest.ply: 120k per photo scene, 25k per object) after a 3.37M-splat room ran at 5 FPS on a Quest 2 (2026-09-27). compose_room prints a ~2 KB summary; the full plan and spec stay in the state dir. A room whose scene (or scans) belong to a project also carries the spec's shared block (docs/WEB_TO_QUEST_PIPELINE.md section 3), from which RoomKit builds the Shared Room rig: Account 1 / Account 2 switcher, personal notes, sealed letters and object tags read live from GET /v1/rooms/{project_id}/shared (snapshot offline). search_images/search_sounds (Openverse) and search_environment (Poly Haven) need the sandbox policy config/nemoclaw/policies/sketchscape-web-media.yaml (GET-only, python3 only); offline they fall back to a curated, URL-verified CC0/CC BY catalog.

unity_mcp_requirements.unity_project: ../HackGTUnity (Unity 6000.6.3f1). The repo's unity/ project has neither the Meta XR SDK nor the Meta MCP extension.
unity_mcp_requirements.packages: com.meta.xr.sdk.all 207.0.0 (Asset Store), com.unity.ai.assistant 2.20.0-pre.1, com.meta.xr.unity-mcp.extension embedded from upstream ac3dd9cdb2675cb0eee98655acb0731349fc6f9e with scripts/unity-mcp-bridge/patches/meta-mcp-extension-unity65-entityid.patch applied
unity_mcp_requirements.why_patched: Upstream GetInteractorsState.cs calls Object.GetInstanceID(), a hard CS0619 error on Unity 6000.5+. It only compiles once the Meta XR SDK interaction package is present, and it then breaks the whole extension assembly, so no meta_ tools appear. See scripts/unity-mcp-bridge/README.md.
unity_mcp_requirements.input_handling: Player Settings > Active Input Handling = Both (activeInputHandler 2), set via the Meta SDK prompt; needs an Editor restart.
